description: ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1, N16R8 (official preferred; compatible board allowed only as a documented deviation)
notes: Q08=B remains the official ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 N16R8 baseline. Official local stock is unconfirmed; the priced prototype board is a compatible N16R8 at Rp139,968. This is an explicit, not silent, deviation. Verify N16R8 marking, RGB GPIO (v1.0=48, v1.1=38), regulator, USB, and pinout.

description: PZEM-004T V4 AC energy meter, 100 A CT (closed or split), TTL/Modbus
alternative_mpn: ADE7953 + CT + isolation; HLW8032 + shunt (not preferred)
notes: Off-board module. The priced prototype uses a closed 100 A CT; a split CT is electrically equivalent for non-invasive sensing and easier to install. Official Peacefair V4 datasheet for the exact batch is not verified. UART level, isolation, terminal rating, and CT ratio must be measured. Do not confuse CT rating with output current rating.
source_evidence: PRD retailer references are availability evidence only, not datasheet. Archive is historical and may not match the purchased V4.

description: AC/DC 5 V 1 A isolated power module, 5 W, 90-264 VAC input
alternative_mpn: Mean Well IRM-05-5 (better documentation/certification, larger); Recom RAC01-05SC (too low current)
notes: Selected by user. 38x23x18 mm, 4 pins (AC/AC/-Vo/+Vo), 5 V 1 A, 5 W. Datasheet claims 2500 VAC input-output isolation and UL/CE design compliance, but the exact batch certificate/isolation/creepage are unverified. Efficiency is only ~70% at 220 V full load, so ~2.1 W heat; thermal test is mandatory. Fuse and MOV belong upstream. Do not touch AC pins; keep mains creepage and barrier.
source_evidence: Distributor copy of Hi-Link HLK-5M05 datasheet (3 pages) with dimension drawing; official product page; exact batch/certification must be verified.

description: I2C real-time clock with integrated crystal, 3.3 V
alternative_mpn: PCF8523T + 32.768 kHz crystal; SNTP holdover only
notes: Battery/supercap holder and drift budget must be selected. Invalid clock blocks automatic ON.
source_evidence: Analog Devices DS3231M datasheet; RTC drift and backup runtime require measurement.

description: N-channel MOSFET relay driver, logic-level, SOT-23
notes: Low-side switch pulls both active-LOW module inputs down. Gate pulldown 100k and series 1k are mandatory for boot-safe OFF. No carrier flyback diode: the module has its own coil drivers. Verify total input current (~15-20 mA per channel), thermal, and module pinout.
source_evidence: AOS datasheet; boot waveform must be measured on a low-voltage fixture.

description: Quad buffer/level shifter, 5 V powered, DIP-14, for PZEM TX and WS2812 data
notes: Converts ESP32 3.3 V logic to 5 V for PZEM RX and WS2812 data. 74HCT input threshold is TTL-compatible. Tie unused inputs to GND; add 100 nF at VCC. Do not use for galvanic isolation.
source_evidence: TI SN74HCT125 datasheet; verify 5 V output levels and PZEM input current.

description: 2-channel 5 V optocoupler relay module, 10 A class claim, off-board, active-low input
alternative_mpn: TE RT2 DPST-NO 8A PCB relay (earlier concept); 2P 16A contactor (larger)
notes: User-selected common 2-channel module, off-board. Two independent SPDT channels (L/N), NOT mechanically linked DPST. 10 A is a vendor claim, not a validated continuous rating. Final 8 A/1840 W. Active-LOW input; verify JD-VCC/pinout. Priced module is a generic optocoupler board; relay brand/batch/rating/lifecycle are unverified.
source_evidence: Handsontec 2Ch relay datasheet; DigiKey TS0010D; verify exact batch/pinout/rating on arrival.
